'''January 2001 Normal tournament (27 January)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament on 27 January 2001. It is known from Geoff Snider's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1682">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-28-geoffs-normal-real-reportd1682/ geoffs-normal-real-report], DeckTech (Geoff "gsiva" Snider, 28 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-28-geoffs-normal-real-reportd1682/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 27 January 2001
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 12
